rationale: Official publication invites exploration and reuse, while general website terms restrict copying without resolving their applicability to GTFS payloads. No feed-specific private temporary retention permission established. This record does not authorize capture.
open_question: Does the announced GTFS open-data reuse cover keeping at most 12 original VehiclePosition payloads privately for seven days for offline diagnosis, without redistribution or commercial use, and is a 60-second request interval compatible with the published service conditions?
retention_proposal: Owner reviews within seven days; no automatic deletion. Delete originals and identifying derived reports only after owner review; keep a non-identifying summary if appropriate.
